# Cat's Creations

> Cat's Creations is a graphic design and brand identity studio based in Pretoria, South Africa, run by Cathy Viviers (founder) with a small team including Sabine (graphic designer), Wallace (web master), and Claude (AI assistant). The studio has 19 years of design and print experience, starting with Cathy running her own print shop. It designs logos, brand identities, social media graphics, print materials, packaging, large format, and digital assets for local and international clients. Cat's Creations is transparent about using AI tools as part of its workflow.

Cat's Creations holds a 5.0-star rating across 22+ verified client reviews on Upwork. Services are available in-person in Pretoria (Gauteng) and fully online to clients across South Africa and worldwide.

## Who We Are

- **Founder:** Cathy Viviers — brand identity designer with 19 years in design, print, and marketing. Started her career running a print shop, giving her hands-on knowledge of production, materials, and what actually survives the hand-off to a printer or fabricator.
- **Sabine** — graphic designer specialising in visual content, Canva, and Adobe suite.
- **Wallace** — web master responsible for the website and digital infrastructure.
- **Claude** — AI assistant supporting brainstorming, writing, and strategy. All artwork, logos, and design work are human-made.

## Services

- [Logo & Brand Identity Design](https://catscreations.co.za/services/logo-brand-identity.html): Custom logo design, colour palettes, typography systems, brand guidelines, stationery concepts, and source files in all formats. Built around each client's business, not a template.
- [Brand Strategy](https://catscreations.co.za/services/brand-strategy.html): Positioning, target audience definition, core messaging, tone of voice, and competitive differentiation. A practical document the client can hand to any designer or marketer.
- [Social Media Graphics](https://catscreations.co.za/services/social-media-graphics.html): Posts, stories, reels covers, banners, and editable Canva templates for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Pinterest.
- [Digital Content Creation](https://catscreations.co.za/services/digital-content-creation.html): Captions, copywriting, infographics, carousels, and digital marketing materials tailored to a client's brand voice.
- [Print Design](https://catscreations.co.za/services/print-design.html): Business cards, letterheads, flyers, posters, brochures, menus, event programmes. All files delivered bleed-ready, CMYK, print-specification-checked.
- [Packaging & Large Format](https://catscreations.co.za/services/packaging-large-format.html): Product boxes, labels, pouches, vehicle wraps, building signage, banners, pull-up stands, exhibition displays, and billboard layouts.
- [Web & Digital Assets](https://catscreations.co.za/services/web-digital-assets.html): Website banners, email headers, digital ad creative (Google Display, Facebook, Instagram), presentation decks, and newsletter templates.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does logo design cost in Pretoria?**
Cat's Creations provides custom quotes based on the scope of each project. To get a quote, use the contact form at catscreations.co.za.

**How long does a brand identity project take?**
A typical logo and brand identity project takes 5–10 business days from briefing to final delivery, depending on revision rounds and client feedback turnaround.

**Do you work with clients outside Pretoria?**
Yes. While based in Pretoria, Gauteng, the studio works with clients across South Africa and internationally via email and online collaboration.

**What's the difference between a logo and a brand identity?**
A logo is a single mark. A brand identity is the complete system: logo, colour palette, typography, brand guidelines, and often stationery and supporting assets. Cat's Creations delivers both.

**Do you deliver print-ready files?**
Yes. Every print file is delivered bleed-ready, in CMYK colour mode, at the correct resolution, and checked against standard printer specifications.

**Can I edit the social media templates myself?**
Yes. Social media graphics can be delivered as editable Canva templates so clients can update captions, dates, and details without needing design software.

**Do you work with existing branding?**
Yes. Packaging, print, and social media work can be created to match an existing brand identity. Logo refreshes and brand updates are also offered.

**Do you build websites?**
No. Cat's Creations focuses on visual brand assets — logos, graphics, print, and digital materials — not website development. Web and digital assets (banners, ad creative, email templates) are offered.

**How do I get started?**
Fill in the contact form at catscreations.co.za or use the form on any service page. Cathy replies within 24 hours.
